title: Matching requests share a generation
summary:
Concurrent generation requests can share a result, three community projects joined the listings, and the API docs got easier to navigate.

Concurrent matching requests to Enter’s generation proxy now share one result instead of starting separate generations. Responses that reuse the result include `X-Cache: HIT` and `X-Cache-Type: DEDUP`; requests made later still run normally.

The project listings added Nosde Space for multimedia creation and remixing, TeleChars AI for configurable Telegram characters, and Imgoo for image generation and editing.

A generated Markdown reference now covers gateway quick starts and endpoint schemas. The README and API docs point developers toward the unified API and mark the older image and text endpoints for future deprecation. Reused OpenAPI schemas were also consolidated, shrinking the spec by 13.5%.

highlights.title: Concurrent requests share results
highlights.text: Send matching generation requests at the same time and they can share one result. Reused responses carry `X-Cache: HIT` and `X-Cache-Type: DEDUP`; sequential requests still run separately. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
